say:1:1230831001:1.text: Well, I've lost count of how many days I've been stuck in this port!
say:1:1230831001:1.source_cn: 我已经数不清自己被困在这座港口多少日子了！

say:2:1230831002:1.text: Now that I can finally leave, it's almost too good to be true.
say:2:1230831002:1.source_cn: 现在好不容易可以离开这里，我却突然感觉有些不真实。

say:3:1230831003:1.text: It feels like at any moment there could be some order from the upper district to close the port again.
say:3:1230831003:1.source_cn: 仿佛下一刻，上城区又会传出通知，告诉我港口再次封锁。

say:4:1230831004:1.text: With Dura's blessing, I can finally leave Rustport behind!
say:4:1230831004:1.source_cn: 艾雅保佑，请让我平安离开锈锚港吧！
